title: The Paradigm Shift: A Comprehensive Survey on Large Vision Language Models for Multimodal Fake News Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Reviewing model performance on specialized datasets (e.g., VERITE) that balance modalities and eliminate asymmetric multimodal disinformation to prevent models from relying on single-modality shortcuts.
Discussing zero-shot decoding and contextual calibration methods that subtract a prior estimated from a content-free prompt to alleviate label prediction skew.

Analyzing the reliance of current Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) on superficial training data correlations rather than causal evidence, and proposing future evaluations using counterfactual reasoning and invariant risk minimization to disentangle these confounding factors.
